purpose: Test whether cedar's real cache optimizer consumes the P5A is_random hint and moves the chosen cache boundary relative to a counterfactual with that one hint removed.
claim_boundary: Plan-level consumption of cedar's randomness hint on the official synthetic profile only. This is not an independent corpus, executed cache, training-benefit, safety, or performance result. fix/depends_on consumption is not tested here.
pass_rule: All commit, freeze, runtime, single-variable, logical-graph, and two-arm plan assertions pass; the two optimized paths differ only in cache placement relative to the changed randomness boundary.
non_claims: The counterfactual is deliberately unsafe metadata removal, not a competing safety method.
The official profile is reused calibration data and does not measure AutoContract benefit.
A selected plan is not evidence that the cache executes correctly on Windows.
No end-to-end throughput, cost, model accuracy, or independent generalization result is produced.
